seoTitle: Recurring Date Generator: Every Second Tuesday, Last Friday and More
metaDescription: List every date for a rule like the second Tuesday of each month or every 10 days within a range. Free.
intro: Lists dates that match a repeating rule: n-th or last weekday of each month, every N days or weeks, a day of the month or the last day.
why:
Meeting series, billing days and shifts follow rules like the second Tuesday or the last Friday. Pick a rule and range to see every date.

The weekday results match the python-dateutil rrule library on four rules over 18 months.
howTo: Set weekday, N and the range.

faq.q: How do I get the last Friday?
faq.a: Choose Nth weekday of each month, set last and Friday.

faq.q: What if the day does not exist?
faq.a: Months without that day are skipped, like the 31st in April.
